system.description: In the heightened focus of battle, your will becomes indomitable. Like a monk with unflinching mental focus or a berserker who is too bloodthirsty to be stopped, you cannot be thwarted by fear, charm, or similar attempts to overcome your willpower.
system.effect: While you are in a battle trance, you are immune to banes that target your Resolve. If you were already under the effect of such a bane, it is negated for the duration of your battle trance and returns when your battle trance ends.
